item.description:
### Website blocking now holds in Firefox and Zen
Firefox and Zen only build the page structure Kahf Guard reads once they're asked to, and that request could quietly go unanswered — a browser that started while the machine was busy stayed unreadable for as long as it ran, and blocked sites opened normally in it. Kahf Guard now keeps asking until the browser actually answers, so blocking comes up within a moment of the window appearing instead of not at all.
### Your exact build, on the Profile screen
Every release carries the version 1.0, which made it impossible to tell support which build you were on. The Profile screen now shows the build number alongside it.
